text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm preparing for the Unity
Cup
finals, I receive a visit from Little
Cocon in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Listen.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If we end up running against your team
during the
finals...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Those girls had better run like they
mean it.
There's no point running against
a team if they
don't put up a proper
fight.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all. Bye.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what a coincidence! Did you come
to
declare war on them too?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: What?! A-as if I'd do such a thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After listening to Little Cocon and Bitter
Glasse's
challenge...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> seems a little
more fired
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our team is fired up!
